Historical full-card image of [[C-3PO (See-Threepio) (V) (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour) (Remastered 2006)|C-3PO (See-Threepio)]], matching the [[Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.
